name: Agent Kernel
summary: The installed agent context, templates, prompt rules, and response conventions that let a Codex enter Farplane with the right operating shape.

name: Work Loop
summary: The durable loop that turns intent into plans, tickets, skills, implementation, and reviewable proof for one bounded unit of work.

name: Horizon Loop
summary: The longer-running project loop that coordinates goals, Goal Packets, Pulse, Interval, backoff, PR watching, feedback, and horizon-level ticket supply.

name: Invocation Runtime
summary: The explicit invocation, board adapter, compute selector, and external-runner boundary that keep Farplane an invocation/proof layer rather than a hidden daemon.

name: Proof And Review
summary: The QA, review, completion, and adversarial testing surfaces that keep Farplane work evidence-backed instead of self-certified.

name: Skill System
summary: The reusable expertise layer: skill tiers, packaging, templates, evals, QA checklists, registry intelligence, and maintenance constraints.

name: Self-Improvement And Learning
summary: The learning loop that observes behavior gaps, captures hardcases, chooses metrics, routes correction, and turns repeated failures into skills, evals, or docs.

name: Source And Sidecar Systems
summary: The external-source, inspiration, video-to-skill, and sidecar-product surfaces that let Farplane adapt useful patterns without making them live dependencies.

name: Maintenance And Release OS
summary: The registries, lifecycle rules, manifests, rollout checks, adoption scans, and docs validators that keep Farplane coherent as it evolves.

name: Domain Skill Families
summary: The specialized skill families for frontend, media, content, and future vertical workflows that build on the core Work Loop and Skill System.
